record.t: Was a keynote speaker at the AEDD transitional housing groundbreaking ceremony in Cabot.
record.q: Keynote speakers include Mark Conine, ADFA Director; Representative Brian S. Evans, Speaker of the House; and Cabot Mayor Ken Kincade who supports the efforts of AEDD.

record.t: Served as Speaker of the Arkansas House of Representatives starting in 2025.
record.q: First Term House 2019; 2021; 2023; Speaker of the House 2025

record.t: Was listed among the representatives scheduled to present the ATRS Legislative Package bills at the Joint Retirement Committee meeting on February 22, 2021.
record.q: Representative Les Warren , Representative John Maddox , Representative Brian S. Evans , Representative Stu Smith , and I will present the bills in the ATRS Legislative Package.

record.t: Joined the groundbreaking for the Lyon College School of Veterinary Medicine in Cabot.
record.q: State and local leaders, including Speaker of the Arkansas House of Representatives Rep. Brian Evans and state Sen. Ricky Hill, both of Cabot

record.t: Told House members that the legislature remains on track to conclude the Fiscal Session.
record.q: Speaker Brian S. Evans told members the legislature remains on track to conclude the Fiscal Session […]

record.t: Sponsored HB1339, which would repeal some obsolete language and let ATRS treat all members the same in counting accumulated sick leave pay in the final average salary.
record.q: HB1339 , sponsored by Rep. Brian Evans , will repeal some obsolete language and allow ATRS to treat all members the same in regard to including compensation for accumulated sick leave in the final average salary.

record.t: Sponsored HB1340, which would add fairness to the process ATRS uses to resolve errors involving unreported service.
record.q: HB1340 , sponsored by Rep. Brian Evans , will add fairness to the process that ATRS uses to resolve errors involving unreported service.
